decisions: 1B XRP is eligible for escrow finish at Nov1 00:00 UTC; it is not an executed release or sale.
The 2B context is 1B reported in two Ripple-labelled account balances Oct29 plus 1B still escrowed; do not label 2B unlocked, circulating or sold.
70% trailing-12-month re-escrow is a historical baseline, not a rule.
$16T product volume, $150B Ripple Payments lifetime volume and secondary $13T Treasury volume are distinct and none discloses XRP-routed volume.
SBI Remit's XRP bridge is documented in a 2023 company announcement; current volume and inventory unknown.
BNY XRP custody support is institutional access, not proof of balances or purchases.
Coinbase RLUSD distribution is separate from native XRP demand; Global Exchange collateral support was planned, not live at launch.
ETF flow series remain provider/date specific; no averaging or spot-execution inference.
No directional feature admitted; no forecast issued.
required_verification: Capture both escrow objects and both Ripple-labelled accounts at pinned validated ledgers before/after Nov1 00:00 UTC.
Record EscrowFinish hashes, submitters, amounts, Destination and subsequent transfers/EscrowCreate.
Obtain corridor-level XRP settlement and inventory data for Ripple Payments and SBI Remit.
Reconcile ETF issuer creations/redemptions and cash/in-kind routes.
Verify BNY customer XRP custody balances and Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral activation.
